TRANSPARENCY BREAKDOWN

What's Included in Every Cael Hub Application?

We believe building a business shouldn't come with hidden catches, monthly software taxes, or vendor lock-in. Here is our direct answer to what is included:

💻
FULL ACCESS

Do you receive the source code?

Yes, full source code access. You receive the complete, unminified codebase for both frontend mobile apps and backend APIs, giving you total freedom to customize business logic, implement local payment integrations, and scale without constraints.

🏷️
100% YOUR BRAND

Can you use your own company name and logo?

Yes, complete white-label ownership. Replace all Cael Hub branding with your company name, logo, custom color palette, app icons, splash screens, and domain. It is 100% your brand facing your clients and staff.

🚀
INCLUDED

Is deployment assistance included?

Yes, guided onboarding & AI support. You get comprehensive step-by-step documentation, turnkey setup guides, and automated guidance from CAELIN to help you configure, build, and deploy your apps to private distribution or app stores.

☁️
DIRECT RATES

Are hosting and third-party services included?

Transparent infrastructure. Cael Hub applications and source code are 100% free with zero licensing fees. You run on your preferred cloud (free tiers supported like Render/Supabase/Firebase) and connect your own API keys (Google Maps, SMS OTP, payment processors) paying raw provider rates with zero markup from us.

💸
₱0 / $0 FOREVER

Are there any setup or maintenance costs?

Zero setup fees and zero ongoing licensing fees. Cael Hub charges ₱0 upfront, ₱0 ongoing royalties, and ₱0 monthly software fees. No surprise billing, contracts, or vendor lock-in.

✦ 100% free white-label deployment • Source code access • Zero ongoing licensing fees
